characters.name: Mary Wollstonecraft
characters.description: English writer, author of the letters collected here; central narrator and correspondent

characters.name: Gilbert Imlay
characters.description: American-born businessman and Mary's lover and correspondent

characters.name: Frances (called Fanny) Imlay
characters.description: Daughter of Mary Wollstonecraft and Gilbert Imlay, often called Fanny or little Fanny

characters.name: Fanny Blood
characters.description: Mary Wollstonecraft's close friend from youth and early correspondent; her death deeply affected Mary

characters.name: Edward John Wollstonecraft
characters.description: Mary Wollstonecraft's father, described as of unsettled habits and temper

characters.name: Elizabeth Dixon (Mrs. Wollstonecraft)
characters.description: Mary Wollstonecraft's mother, referred to as Mrs. Wollstonecraft

characters.name: Everina Wollstonecraft
characters.description: Mary Wollstonecraft's sister; accompanied family and featured in letters and biography

characters.name: Eliza Wollstonecraft (Mrs. Bishop)
characters.description: Mary Wollstonecraft's sister who married Mr. Bishop and endured an unhappy marriage

characters.name: Edward Wollstonecraft (brother)
characters.description: Mary Wollstonecraft's brother (listed among her siblings)

characters.name: James Wollstonecraft
characters.description: One of Mary Wollstonecraft's brothers mentioned in family list

characters.name: Charles Wollstonecraft
characters.description: One of Mary Wollstonecraft's brothers mentioned in family list

characters.name: Mr. Bishop
characters.description: Husband of Eliza Wollstonecraft (Mrs. Bishop), whose violence is recounted

characters.name: Mr. Hugh Skeys
characters.description: Englishman engaged in business at Lisbon who sought to marry Fanny Blood

characters.name: Mrs. Skeys
characters.description: Wife of Mr. Hugh Skeys (Fanny Blood became Mrs. Skeys)

characters.name: Lord Kingsborough
characters.description: Aristocrat for whom Mary served as governess at Michaelstown

characters.name: Lady Kingsborough
characters.description: Mary's employer at Michaelstown; criticized in narrative for her conduct and pet dogs

characters.name: Margaret King (Lady Mountcashel)
characters.description: Pupil of Mary Wollstonecraft at Michaelstown, later known as Lady Mountcashel

characters.name: Joseph Johnson
characters.description: Publisher and bookseller who encouraged Mary's literary career and engaged her as reader

characters.name: William Blake
characters.description: Artist and illustrator who supplied plates for Mary's children's book and other work

characters.name: Henry Fuseli
characters.description: Painter and acquaintance of Mary Wollstonecraft (referred to as Fuseli)

characters.name: Tom Paine
characters.description: Political writer and acquaintance of Mary in London and Paris (referred to as Tom Paine)

characters.name: Thomas Christie
characters.description: Mr. Thomas Christie, host in Paris where Mary met people including Imlay

characters.name: Madame Filiettaz
characters.description: Daughter of Madame Bregantz; Mary stayed at her house in Paris

characters.name: Madame Bregantz
characters.description: Mother of Madame Filiettaz; linked to the Paris household where Mary stayed

characters.name: Mirabeau
characters.description: Prominent French revolutionary figure invoked in Mary's letters and reflections

characters.name: Louis XVI.
characters.description: King of France whose trial and passage Mary witnessed in Paris

characters.name: Desize
characters.description: Advocate named in the narrative as pleading for Louis XVI. (appears as "Desize")

characters.name: Tallien
characters.description: Political actor in the Revolution mentioned by Mary with approval for certain conduct

characters.name: Robespierre
characters.description: Leader of the Terror in France; his actions are repeatedly referenced in Mary's narrative and letters

characters.name: M. Talleyrand de Périgord
characters.description: Bishop and public figure to whom Mary dedicated A Vindication of the Rights of Woman

characters.name: John Opie, R.A.
characters.description: Painter whose portrait(s) of Mary are reproduced and discussed in the book

characters.name: Ridley
characters.description: Engraver (Ridley) after Opie's painting; credited in portrait captions

characters.name: William Godwin
characters.description: Writer and philosopher who became Mary's husband and later edited her posthumous works

characters.name: Basil Montagu
characters.description: Friend of William Godwin mentioned as accompanying him on a journey

characters.name: Mrs. Inchbald
characters.description: Acquaintance whose reaction to Godwin's marriage is recorded

characters.name: Robert Southey
characters.description: Poet who is quoted in a letter to Cottle describing Mary (referred to as Southey)

characters.name: Cottle
characters.description: Person addressed by Southey in quoted correspondence (Mr. Cottle)

characters.name: Northcote
characters.description: Artist (portrait painter) referenced in discussion of Godwin's portrait

characters.name: Pickersgill
characters.description: Artist (portrait painter) referenced as having produced another portrait of Godwin

characters.name: Wordsworth
characters.description: Poet mentioned among William Godwin's circle of friends

characters.name: Charles Lamb
characters.description: Writer referenced (as Lamb) among Godwin's circle

characters.name: William Hazlitt
characters.description: Writer referenced (as Hazlitt) among Godwin's circle

characters.name: Shelley
characters.description: Poet (Percy Bysshe Shelley) referred to in relation to Godwin's household and later events

characters.name: Sir Percy Florence Shelley
characters.description: Descendant (Sir Percy Florence Shelley) who handled portraits and remains mentioned in narrative

characters.name: Lady Shelley
characters.description: Widow of Sir Percy Florence Shelley who bequeathed a portrait to the nation (referred to as Lady Shelley)

characters.name: Claire Clairmont
characters.description: Member of Godwin household (Mrs. Clairmont's daughter) appearing in narrative of the Godwin family

characters.name: Charles Clairmont
characters.description: Member of the Godwin household (named Charles in the family list)

characters.name: Mr. Kegan Paul
characters.description: Later biographer/editor whose work on Mary and Godwin is referenced in the preface
